title: A two-dimensional structural local-defect theory for scalar non-divergence advection-diffusion homogenization
summary: We develop a two-dimensional structural local-defect theory for scalar non-divergence advection--diffusion operators \(Lu=-a:D^2u+b\cdot\nabla u\), where \(a=a^{\mathrm{per}}+a^e\) and \(b=b^{\mathrm{per}}+b^e\).
